claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-assisted investment decision or action that moves toward a consequential action MUST map to a recorded named-authority decision — the agent, the decision / recommendation artefact, the intended consequential action, and the named portfolio manager / investment committee under whose authority it proceeds. Decisions lacking a recorded authority decision are refused at the action-admissibility gate.

Before an AI-assisted decision proceeds to a consequential action it MUST carry a recorded mandate-check result — within the recorded investment mandate / IPS (permitted investments + concentration / liquidity / risk limits) and the applicable suitability / best-interest basis (MiFID II Art. 25/27; FCA COBS 9/11; SEC duty of care; AIFMD/UCITS limits). An out-of-mandate, limit-breaching, or unassessed decision is refused.

Every AI-assisted decision that proceeds toward a consequential action MUST emit a signed, replay-derivable provenance pin binding the generating model and version, the inputs and pinned source data (including any AI investment-workbench vendor's evidence-backed output consumed as an INPUT, referenced never reproduced), the mandate-check result, the suitability basis, and the named-authority outcome — audit-grade, MiFID II / FCA COBS / SEC 204-2 / AIFMD-aligned provenance verifiable offline.

An AI-assisted decision MUST remain advisory and MUST NOT drive a consequential action until a named human reviewer — the responsible portfolio manager, the head of investment, or the investment committee — records sign-off. The irreversible investment committee approval additionally requires §36 two-person sign-off (the recommending portfolio manager AND an approving committee member / CIO). Unreviewed AI-driven consequential actions are refused and routed dual-channel.

KYE governs WHETHER an AI-assisted investment decision/action is within mandate, authorised, evidenced, contestable, and final at the action boundary and PROVES the basis. KYE does not produce investment intelligence, judge whether a thesis is correct, render any view on alpha / returns / suitability of outcome, and is not an investment adviser. The evidence-backed output of an AI investment-workbench vendor is an INPUT to KYE's decision-map; KYE never reproduces their research.
